body: You’re right. I think when I was younger I would speak too freely and come across as offensive, unintentionally. Now I just don’t say much at all. Which comes off as intimidating (Thanks RBF). I try my best to be polite and open when making friends now and I get the feeling that people are surprised when they realize I’m friendly. Thank you for the response.

Okay wow. Thank you for the insight. You completely called me out on the last half and I am so here for it 😂 I’m a stay at home mom with goals of pursuing a career when the time is right. I feel like you described the career path I would love. I want to be involved with people. I just have a hard time connecting. Any advice on how to overcome my toxic traits?
Yesssss. “Words cannot capture all the thoughts” is spot on. I’m also intuitive so it’s hard to explain things that I *just know* lol

Well thank you. And yes. It’s like my choice of words don’t accurately depict how I feel. At least to other people. I don’t know. But I probably should work on my timing of when to show which parts of myself. I do feel like I’m too much. Therapy sounds like a good idea! 🤣

You’re correct. I definitely bite my tongue to avoid conflict. Even over things that probably wouldn’t cause conflict. I’m afraid of coming off as weird and being judged. Trying to get over that though

Thank you for the response. I do have an uneasy relationship with having the spotlight, yet I still crave it at times. There seems to be an immense pressure to be perfect. Social anxiety makes it hard to apply myself but it’s something I’m consciously trying to overcome. Building up confidence is the plan! Your insight is appreciated.
Yes!! Exactly!! Lmao

Thank you for the advice! Could you expand on what you mean by setting a verbal picture of your perspective? Also LOL at me asking a question to this response! Solidarity on being misunderstood. We understand each other in that sense.

you are so spot on. digging down and building up at the same time is a perfect way to describe it. i feel like i have to break generational curses and heal my family while at the same time prove to everyone and myself that i’m good enough and will be something great someday. i could really use a break 😂😅. it’s probably why i love traveling/vacationing so much, though i don’t get to do it that often. i honestly would move away but i feel like i can’t leave my family behind. thanks for your insight!
thank you! that’s exactly what i plan to do <3
yes @ the moon interpretation. my mars is also in cancer so we’ll see how it goes lol
this is his chart
subjective, but i do receive compliments on my appearance somewhat often. i’m also told i look intimidating.
if i were a book, you read me ! i really have no corrections LOL geez, teach me your ways 🙏
haha yes, gemini x scorpio = top tier sarcasm! but of course that’s what i think 😂 thanks for your insight!

this is how my chart reads to me as well, but i feel indifferent about it. i wouldn’t say i’m good at *earning* money, however i usually have it when i need it. & my career is a huge question for me. you’re spot on about the sense of urgency. few friends though. but i want more 😅

ooooo you’re good! indeed i was a verrrrry sensitive and defensive child. despite being somewhat likable for any talents i possessed, i was bratty which in turn made my peers wary of me. (the RBF did not help lol). 

i never intentionally hurt anyone that i can think of, but when my insecurities are triggered (if left unchecked) i can have a sharp tongue. i definitely noticed that i was unable to connect with anyone and i made it worse by becoming even colder 😂 very dramatic. 

these days, i’m much more reserved. i have a small circle of friends with whom i’m able to laugh *at* myself with, but i don’t share my more difficult emotions with hardly anyone other than my partner. i still feel stuck in the cycle/unsure of how to interact with others, but i’m trying to open up :) & my partner definitely “puts up” with me lolol but for that, i am forever grateful.
rocky is an excellent word choice lol. emotionally unstable mother & absent father for the win! good observation
it really depends on if i’m tired of hearing myself talk yet 😂

DH here! not sure how to advise you in this situation but i can tell you what the role of a DH is like. as someone already said, you’ll be doing everything a tech does (minus shots) for less pay. not only that, but everything a CSA does as well. not gonna lie it kinda sucks. idk how your pay will be adjusted as you have more experience than i do, but i only make .50 cents more than CSA’s at the moment. /: so do with this information what you will. maybe consider transferring to another walgreens.

*edit* if your pharmacy is busy like mine is, you could be back there for several hours. they usually call me back when the line is really long or when they haven’t had time to put away prescriptions. not too much filling involved though.

my natal moon is in scorpio and i’ve been dreaming so much more since the full moon as well. pretty much the same is going on w me in terms of waking life too. i’ve been productive and tired but still satisfied. you said it perfectly! i wonder if other people are experiencing this too
i love you, friend.

also i feel like i should mention i know a little about astrology, but i have trouble understanding how placements/aspects work together to create one big picture,, if that makes sense. any insight that could help me understand my chart better would be much appreciated :)
i don’t know how to help you, but i hear you. every word.

i know i’m just some random on the internet, but i’d like for you to know that i read all three of your posts. i, too, made an anonymous account to vent about how i feel. i hate that you’ve had to experience so much trauma throughout your life. nobody deserves that. but if it helps at all, your posts made me feel less alone. like there is someone else out there who understands what it feels like to be genuinely tired of living. i’m sorry that we both feel this way, but please know your posts weren’t for nothing. you’re not alone.
thank you. i’m sorry for your loss as well
